messages:

Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor activation — CloudFlux (next steps)

Hi Alex / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We're excited to get CloudFlux set up as an approved supplier for Redwood. Attached is our completed W-9 and a short vendor overview for your records.

Can you share Redwood's vendor onboarding checklist and any PO instructions so we can confirm carrier/billing details? Specifically we need to know:
- Required tax/financial docs (beyond the W-9)
- Insurance and COI minimums
- Expected PO cadence and whether Redwood issues PO before the first invoice
- Banking requirements for ACH vs. wire (form we should fill)

Happy to book a 20–30 minute follow-up if that helps. Tagging our procurement alias on this thread for visibility.

Attachments (sent): CloudFlux_W-9.pdf, CloudFlux_Company_Profile.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor activation — CloudFlux (next steps)

Hi Maria — thanks for sending over the W-9 and profile. Welcome aboard.

I've attached our standard vendor onboarding workbook (Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) which covers legal, tax, banking, and vendor contact details. A few notes to speed things up:
- Please complete the onboarding workbook and return the Banking & ACH tab if you prefer ACH. We accept wire as well, but ACH is faster for recurring payments.
- We require either a current SOC 2 Type II report or completion of our security questionnaire. If you have an ISO certificate, include that too.
- Insurance: Certificate of Insurance (COI) with $1M general liability and $2M E&O is our baseline; include Redwood Inference as certificate holder if possible.
- PO process: Redwood issues a PO for orders/services above $5,000. Our Accounts Payable prefers Net-30 by default; net-45 can be considered for enterprise contracts with approvals.
- If your legal team needs to send a master services agreement (MSA), please mark it "For review" and route to legal@redwood.com; attach with any requested redlines.

I've CC'd Karthik (procurement lead) to pick up the PO and billing workflow items — he'll confirm timeline and the sample PO. Also here's a HubSpot link to the CloudFlux opportunity for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Next steps:
1) Fill and return Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (banking tab if requesting ACH).
2) Upload SOC2/ISO and COI to the shared Drive link or reply with attachments.
3) Karthik will issue a sample PO and confirm expected time to first payment.

If helpful, we can book a 30-minute kickoff next week to run through items. What days work for you?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0228
Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx

Subject: RE: Vendor activation: CloudFlux — activation requirements & PO clarifications

Hi Maria / Alex,

Thanks for the questions — looping in AP and formalizing the path so we can get CloudFlux live by mid-February. Quick answers and actions below:

Answers:
- Initial invoice without a PO: We can approve a one-time initial invoice without a PO for onboarding/setup work if the scope and amount are documented and approved by the buyer (Alex). Please include the project reference (Redwood Integration – CloudFlux) on the invoice.
- Net-45 requests: For an exception to Net-30 we need a brief finance exception request (one paragraph stating reason) and a signed SOW or MSA that shows milestone/payment schedule. Send that to ap@redwood.com and cc me.
- COI wording: Please list "Redwood Inference, Inc., 800 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103" as certificate holder. Project description is optional but helpful. Minimum: $1,000,000 GL and $2,000,000 E&O.

Attachments: I've added a sample PO and our PO instructions for vendors to this thread: Sample_PO_CloudFlux.pdf; Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf.

Action items for CloudFlux (please complete by EOD 2/14 to keep timeline):
1) Return completed Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (banking tab if ACH).
2) Upload SOC 2 Type II report or complete our security questionnaire.
3) Provide COI with Redwood Inference as certificate holder.
4) If requesting Net-45 for first invoice, send finance exception note + signed SOW/MSA to ap@redwood.com.

Let's do the 30-min kickoff on Tue 2/7 at 10:00am PT as Alex suggested — calendar invite incoming. If there are any blockers on required docs, flag them in email and we'll work around.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0789
